package.name: kotek_isaac_stage
package.description: Offline USD stage authoring for the demo scene: overlays a graspable sensor object and the drive/articulation fixes described in plan section 11 onto the existing scout_and_piper_ros2_final.usd, without modifying it. Runs under plain usd-core (pip install usd-core) -- it does not need Isaac Sim or ROS 2, so it is intentionally not run as part of the ROS graph; see kotek_ws/README.md.
